findings.summary: New `hm proposals summary` reader consumes a base-tier file Step 5.3 still writes via raw, unlocked Edit/Write across concurrent fleet wrapups — a pre-existing lost-update race now surfaces as an under-counted advisory line
findings.suggestion: Follow-up PLAN: route Step 5.3 through a locked `hm memory_md`-style CLI verb, mirroring 5.1/5.2.

reasoning.observe: wrapup.md.j2:400 documents 5.1/5.2 moved to the locked memory CLI after 5 wiki entries were lost; :489 (Step 5.3, unchanged by this diff) still writes pending-proposals.md raw.
reasoning.trace: This diff adds proposals.py + an `hm proposals summary` call that reads the same base-tier file.
reasoning.infer: Concurrent Step 5.3 writes can lose an update; the new reader then under-counts.
reasoning.conclude: Pre-existing write race made observable as a wrong advisory count; advisory-only and parser-tolerant, so P2.

findings.summary: test_excerpt_keeps_multiple_whole_blocks_when_they_fit never reaches the block-selection loop (47-byte body under a 4000-byte cap returns on the early-exit path)
findings.suggestion: Use a 3-block body exceeding max_bytes so the newest two survive whole and the oldest is evicted whole; assert dropped > 0.

reasoning.trace: _excerpt_recent_blocks returns (body, 0) when total <= max_bytes before splitting.
reasoning.infer: All assertions hold for any implementation of the loop.
reasoning.conclude: The whole-block selection path has no real coverage.

findings.summary: test_cli_no_count_floor_reproduces_the_pre_floor_output only proves --no-count-floor == --count-floor 0 (same code path), not pre-floor preservation its name claims
findings.suggestion: Rename to what it verifies (flag-alias equivalence) or compare the off-path against an independently captured pre-feature render.

reasoning.observe: Both invocations take the count_floor==0 branch; assertion is a.stdout == b.stdout.
reasoning.trace: --no-count-floor is store_const const=0 into the same dest.
reasoning.infer: A bug in the shared 0-floor branch passes unchanged.
reasoning.conclude: Name over-claims; weak oracle for the stated property.

findings.summary: execute's warm-tier item 3 (unfiltered wiki.md head skim) now duplicates item 2's memory_retrieve wiki coverage
findings.suggestion: Drop item 3, or state why an unfiltered wiki read is still needed beside the topic-scored fence.

reasoning.observe: item 2 now surfaces wiki + failures bodies via memory_retrieve; item 3 still skims wiki.md first 40 lines.
reasoning.trace: Before, item 2 read failures only; now both read wiki.md.
reasoning.infer: Two overlapping wiki reads per execute run with no stated reason.
reasoning.conclude: Redundant instruction left unexamined; not a blocker.

findings.summary: --floor-entry-bytes 0을 허용하지만 Python의 [-0:]는 전체 문자열을 반환합니다. 따라서 본문 예산을 무시하거나 고빈도 항목을 조용히 누락합니다. 음수도 검증 없이 잘못된 슬라이스로 처리됩니다. CLI에서 비양수를 거부하거나 helper에서 명시적으로 처리하고 경계값 테스트를 추가해야 합니다.
findings.evidence: _excerpt_recent_blocks('abcdef', 0)는 ('abcdef', 0)을 반환합니다. floor_entry_bytes=0으로 렌더링하면 100바이트 본문은 그대로 출력되고, 2000바이트 본문은 section cap에 걸려 항목 전체가 사라집니다.

findings.summary: 이 테스트는 이름과 달리 변경 전 출력의 보존을 검증하지 않습니다. 두 비활성화 플래그의 동등성만 확인하므로 lexical 출력이 양쪽에서 똑같이 잘못 변경되어도 통과합니다. 독립적으로 작성한 기대 출력과 비교하고 단일 oversized 항목 및 multi-entry cap 경로도 포함해야 합니다.
findings.evidence: 두 호출 모두 변경된 동일 renderer를 사용하고, 마지막 검증은 a.stdout == b.stdout뿐입니다.

findings.summary: 문서의 무조건적인 'never 0'은 유지하기로 한 스키마 계약과 모순됩니다. review.md.j2에도 같은 금지가 추가되었습니다. 실제 측정값 0은 유효하므로 '측정하지 않은 값을 0으로 대체하지 말 것'으로 한정해야 합니다. 이를 해결하려고 스키마에서 0을 금지하면 기존 레코드 호환성을 깨뜨립니다.
findings.evidence: ReviewTelemetryRecord는 Field(default=None, ge=0)이며, 새 test_null_is_distinct_from_zero도 측정값 0의 수용을 명시적으로 검증합니다.
